summary: 10.0.41.08 Precision Fixes & Global Decision Dialogs (Actions Menu Restoration, Master Payment Lookups, Email Settings Jackson Serialization, 3-Button Standard Attachment Card, Contextual Monetary Amount Coloring, Delivery Address Interlocking, and Global Modal Dialogs)
highlights: 1. Sales Register Actions Button: Fixed coordinate calculation and relocated '#sales-row-actions-menu' to application root with z-index 100025, completely restoring the purple '::: Actions' dropdown button.
2. Record Payment Lookups: Resolved view loading lifecycle and populated Payment Mode and Bank Account dropdowns purely from live Master Data lookup tables without mock arrays.

3. Corporate Email Settings: Added 'passwordConfigured' boolean to PUT /api/authority/email/settings payload, resolving Jackson null-to-primitive deserialization error while preserving date format integrity.
4. Standardized Attachment Card: Standardized 3-button layout (+ Add / Replace, Preview, Delete) in bottom-right Notes & Attachments card in Sale & Purchase creation, removing top redundant cards.
5. Universal Semantic Amount Coloring: Implemented contextual monetary styling across all registers and tables (Paid/Received = Green, Pending/Due = Yellow/Red, Total = Cyan).
6. Delivery Address Interlocking: Enforced strict readonly interlocking on Delivery Address and GSTIN inputs whenever 'Same as Billing Address' is checked on initial load and party selection.

7. Universal Decision Dialogs: Completely replaced all transient toast popups across the entire ERP with interactive modal dialogs (success, error, warning, info, exportSuccess) requiring explicit user confirmation.
